RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

An all-women panel selecting a woman over another woman gives you no sex-based grievance — you and the successful candidate share the characteristic. Raising panel composition would read as a complaint that women shouldn't decide, and would damage your credibility on the points that actually matter.

Those points are real. On paper you hold the stronger qualifications: master's, licence, twelve years. But "extensive experience of public consultation" is a substantive signal — councils often prioritise community engagement and political handling over technical depth for director roles. That may be the whole story.

Do chase the written feedback. Two weeks' silence is unreasonable; send a polite follow-up, copying HR, and ask specifically which criteria separated the candidates.
